name: Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. provides general building facility maintenance services in Japan and internationally. The company develops equipment maintenance plans; maintenance and management/maintenance and renewal; diagnosis and evaluation of equipment; and validation support. It also offers radiation dose measurement; measurement of radioactive material concentration in wastewater; as well as technical training services. Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
